status.main_product: Drone surveying, mapping, and industrial inspection services
status.scope_reason: The company directly offers commercial drone aerial surveying, 3D mapping, and photogrammetry services under its brand name across India.
status.evidence: Dronitech explicitly advertises and provides drone aerial land surveying, 3D mapping, and construction progress monitoring services from its headquarters in Mumbai on its official website.

claims.claim: The company reports providing aerial photogrammetry and drone land surveying services integrated with high-definition cameras, positioning systems, and RTK/PPK technology to achieve centimeter-level accuracy for land surveying, mapping, and construction monitoring.
The company reports offering drone surveying with LiDAR systems to produce elevation data and 3D geospatial models processed using specialized CAD and GIS-compatible mapping software.

The company reports offering an Aerial Intelligence Platform that serves as a toolset for visualizing, measuring, and storing spatial data, supporting orthophotography, digital surface models, and 3D terrain models.

The company reports utilizing sophisticated drone mapping software to process collected drone imagery, enabling the generation of 2D maps, 3D models, orthomosaics, digital elevation models, and contour mapping.
The company states that it integrates DGPS surveying and ground control points to deliver engineering-grade horizontal/vertical accuracy and detailed 3D models.
claims.note: The integration of DGPS surveying and ground control points to deliver engineering-grade horizontal/vertical accuracy and detailed 3D models could not be verified explicitly under the company's stated integration list.

claims.claim: The company reports providing drone-based aerial systems mapping services that integrate advanced sensors like thermal cameras, LiDAR technology, and AI-powered imaging systems for industrial monitoring and geospatial surveys.
claims.source: Dronitech Website (Industrial Robotics and Unmanned Systems Solutions Page)

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: Dronitech Aviation reports the internal development of proprietary software tools, including its proprietary "Droniview" software package, which is designed for drone management and flight data tracking.

The company completed 3D mapping and aerial photography for more than 50 level crossings for the Indian Railways across Maharashtra, reporting that the industrial surveys were completed within 7 to 8 days.
